preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profile WHERE id = 1

changeSet.comment: Completa en el perfil Administrador local las acciones de escritura/concesión (SEC-02 y SEC-07)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO profile2action (profile_fk, action_fk) SELECT (SELECT id FROM profile WHERE name = 'Administrador'), a.id FROM action a WHERE a.code IN ('ACTION_WRITE', 'PROFILE_GRANT', 'USER_GRANT') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT (SELECT id FROM profile WHERE name = 'Administrador') FROM profile2action p WHERE p.profile_fk = (SELECT id FROM profile WHERE name = 'Administrador') AND p.action_fk = a.id );

delete.where: profile_fk = (SELECT id FROM profile WHERE name = 'Administrador') AND action_fk IN (SELECT id FROM action WHERE code IN ('PROFILE_GRANT', 'USER_GRANT'))
